region_or_platform_notes: The OpenAI API still serves gpt-5.5. Codex retired gpt-5.5 for ChatGPT sign-in on October 14, 2026 at 19:00 UTC. Codex sessions authenticated with an API key are not affected. For ChatGPT sign-in, the Codex models page names gpt-6.1-sol on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu, and gpt-6-luna on Free and Go.

sources.label: Codex changelog
sources.excerpt: Effective October 14, 2026, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC), GPT-5.5 retires from Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT. The OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key aren't affected.

sources.label: Codex models
sources.excerpt: Effective October 14, 2026, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC), GPT-5.5 retires from Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT. The OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key aren't affected. GPT-5.5 remains available through the OpenAI API and in Codex sessions authenticated with an API key.
